auditors.focus: paper comparison, scientific design, causal claims and conclusions
RSI scoring/selection, model and evaluation pipeline, source and metric attribution
timeline, paid resources, failures/restarts, exports and provenance

independence: Separate AI reviewer instances started without inherited conversation history. Each receives the user audit request and direct scope/authorization quotations. They share underlying project evidence and are not external human auditors. The original implementation agent coordinates and will label its synthesis separately.
scope: Read all project files, original papers and author code, Git/board history, ignored current and archived runtime evidence and checkpoint metadata as needed. Exclude credential contents and unrelated personal files.
constraints: No new training, rollouts, benchmarks, rentals or GPU forward jobs
No scientific configuration or runtime-state changes
Research goal and monitoring remain paused
Auditor reports have separate file ownership; existing evidence/reports remain unchanged during review
limitations: Retained evidence is incomplete where prior artifacts were deleted; absence must be reported
Each finding must distinguish primary raw evidence from agent declarations
Cost is account-credit delta, not provider invoice
Checkpoint full-content hashes must be marked verified, sampled or declared as actually checked
